hotel_name: Hotel O Sk Tower Near Rithala Metro Station

negative_snippets: Its basically a place where rickshaw walas book a room and then drink and play loud music all night. Not at all a good experience, also gives a very shady vibe. Rooms are smelly, there’s a sliced bottle for a mug. Forget about sleeping if you plan to stay here. Walls seem to be paper thin and you can hear what’s happening in other rooms. Not at all recommended.

Total Fraud. Beware of it. Don't believe on the online price. It's a trick to trap the customers. Once you arrive there, the hotel charges more. I have experienced it. I paid Rs 1225 online for two nights. When I arrived in the hotel, receptionist charged Rs 1200 more. So, friends don't visit it.
